name: AI Foundations with ChatGPT
level: Business course · no official exam yet
audience: Professionals in any role who use ChatGPT for everyday work: drafting, summarising, analysis, research and simple automation. No coding needed.
format: This site's course with a 40-question practice test. OpenAI's own certification is in invite-only pilot; this course follows the topics of OpenAI Academy's free courses.
verifyNotes: This is the site's own course; OpenAI has no public certification exam (an invite-only pilot exists). Align topics to OpenAI Academy's free courses. Verify ChatGPT feature names and plan availability against help.openai.com (features rename often, e.g. connectors -> apps); say 'check current plans' rather than asserting plan details that may change.

domains.name: How LLMs work and their limits
skills: Explain next-token prediction, tokens, context window and knowledge cutoff
Explain why the same prompt gives different answers
Recognise hallucination and other failure modes and reduce the risk

domains.name: Prompting for work
skills: Write work prompts with goal, context, role, format, examples and constraints
Iterate like an editor and decompose big tasks
Use everyday prompt patterns: summarise, draft in your voice, analyse, brainstorm, meeting prep

domains.name: Checking and improving output
skills: Scale checking to the stakes; verify facts, numbers and sources
Critique drafts against criteria; use a fresh review over self-review
Check for bias and gaps; know when to stop iterating

domains.name: ChatGPT features and workflows
skills: Choose the right ChatGPT tool: search, deep research, canvas, data analysis, image, agent
Choose a model and reasoning setting for the task
Use custom instructions, memory, Projects, custom GPTs and apps

domains.name: Agents and automation basics
skills: Explain what an agent is and which tasks to delegate
Add human checkpoints; turn prompts into repeatable workflows

domains.name: Safe and responsible use
skills: Follow company policy; minimise sensitive data; know what workspace plans add
Keep accountability and disclose AI use
Handle bias, IP, confidentiality and over-reliance; know usage policy basics
